frozen: All3 BERT checkpoints, all15 detector distributions, training/evaluation features, scores and classifier predictions remain fixed. No inference or fitting.
primary_comparisons: ratio_25 minus ratio_00 and ratio_50 at every target; ratio_10 comparisons supplementary; show entire grid without test-selected winner
historical_reference: clean_reference uses15000 training views; ratio_00/10/25/50 all30000 views and unchanged nested noise subsets

selection.data: Only3000 clean validation IS scores per detector;100 OOS validation rows only evaluated after all cutoffs selected
selection.candidates: Unique IS scores plus nextafter(max_IS,+inf); accept score<threshold, reject score>=threshold
selection.common_count: Intersect attainable counts of all15 detectors, independently choose smallest common count >= each requested target count
selection.cutoff: Smallest candidate threshold achieving the chosen common count for each detector
selection.ties: No randomized tie splitting; disclose requested and attained counts if any target requires moving upward
selection.anchor: 95% cutoffs and decisions must exactly reproduce BERT_Rejection_Alignment_20261019
selection.freeze: All75 cutoffs frozen before any new test rethresholding

stability.direction: For each noisy condition disclose whether25% lies between0% and50% in FR, known wrong-head acceptance and OOS false acceptance at all5 targets; also show per-seed signs
stability.magnitude: Report candidate-reference gaps at every target and gap(target)-gap(95%); shared paired sampling across targets
stability.uncertainty: 2000 paired text-stratified draws for primary25% contrasts, pointwise95% conditional intervals. CI crossing zero is not equivalence; direction stability is not constant magnitude.
stability.clean: Evaluate clean test IS acceptance and OOS F1/recall versus both0%/50% at every target; no posthoc noninferiority tolerance
stability.no_utility: No costs or utility weights specified; no universally best ratio or target claimed

bootstrap.strata: 150 IS intents x30 samples with replacement plus1000 OOS; same source-text draws across ratios,targets,seeds,conditions
bootstrap.seeds: 3 fixed model scores averaged; do not treat them as independent test texts
bootstrap.changes: Compute paired target-minus95 gap changes within each draw; not by subtracting CI endpoints

sensitivity: Exclude inherited train-test original row_ids599/938 identically from all225 settings; report gap and gap-change sensitivity, not a cure for historical exposure
limitations: 95% results and previous tests motivated this exploratory sweep; targets fixed for this turn but test set is reused
Acceptance alignment holds on validation, not as a clean/noisy test guarantee
Pointwise intervals condition on fitted models,distributions,noise realization and selected thresholds; omit refitting/validation calibration uncertainty and multiplicity correction
99% cutoff uses only30 rejected validation IS per model and can be sensitive to the validation tail; no guarantee outside these5 points
One nested training-noise realization and matched synthetic spelling family; natural noise and semantic preservation not independently validated
3 inherited train-validation and2 train-test overlaps remain; exclusion sensitivity does not undo exposure
